title: Actual strict-system site comparison and proper/open transport interfaces
statement:
Let $O$ be a commutative ring, $\lambda\in O$, and $T$ a scheme. Use the strict systems with positive levels $O/(\lambda^{n+1})$, normalized evaluation, and ordinary and derived image data of [def-pur-coefficient-system-image-data], in the ordinary unbounded derived categories [def-weil-abstract-derived-category]. Specialize the ordinary image and derived evaluation interfaces to the small pro-etale site [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site], retaining its coefficient-sized sheafification, additive evaluation and standard derived-category instances. An $\mathrm{ExceptionalSystemSiteComparison}(T,P)$, for a strict etale evaluation package $P$ [def-per-strict-etale-system-interfaces], consists of a pro-etale evaluation package and ordinary and derived image packages for the actual geometric adjunction $\nu_T^*\dashv\nu_{T,*}$ [def-weil-pbc-site-comparison-morphism], including their actual system and level adjunctions, units, counits, evaluation and scalar comparisons.

For a compactification $c=(X\xrightarrow j\overline X\xrightarrow pY)$ [def-weil-compactifications-refinements], $\mathrm{ExceptionalProCompactSupport}$ consists of ordinary open and proper image packages, universal derived images, ordinary open extension left adjoint to restriction, its finite level analogues, derived open extension with the same adjunction, complex-localization factorization isomorphisms and evaluation isomorphisms. Its coherence requires exact open extension, the ordinary evaluated transpose equation, the system and level derived transpose equations on complex representatives, and the representative equation for derived open evaluation. Define $\mathsf F^{pro}$ to be derived open extension followed by derived proper direct image; its evaluation is the paste of those two evaluation isomorphisms.

A system pullback square is an ordinary and level pullback isomorphism together with their derived system and level isomorphisms, fixed by the underlying geometric coefficient pullback, ordinary evaluation and complex-representative localization equations. For strict etale compact support $S$ and site comparison packages $C_X,C_Y,C_{\overline X}$, $\mathrm{ExceptionalSystemCompactificationComparison}$ comprises these proper and open pullback squares, and open-extension comparison isomorphisms at system and finite levels. Their mates [def-weil-pbc-adjunction-mate] are required to be the inverse open pullback squares, and their evaluated open comparison must be the finite one. Define $J:C_Y\mathsf F^{et}\to\mathsf F^{pro}C_X$ as the actual proper adjunction mate followed by the open-extension comparison, and $\kappa:C_Y\mathsf F^{et}V_X\to\mathsf F^{pro}$ by following $J V_X$ with the source site counit. Define their finite versions by the identical words.

For arbitrary adjunctions $F\dashv G$, $C_X\dashv V_X$, $C_Y\dashv V_Y$, a functor $F^p$ and a specified $\kappa:C_Y F V_X\to F^p$, and object properties $P_X,P_Y$, $\mathrm{ExceptionalOriginAdjunction}$ consists of preservation of these properties by $F^p$ and $C_X G V_Y$, an adjunction of their restrictions to the full subcategories, and the following normalization of its transpose. If $h:F^p M\to N$, the transpose, precomposed with the source site counit, is $C_X$ applied to the etale transpose of the composite of the target site unit with $V_Y(\kappa_M;h)$. This fixes the actual restricted unit and counit. These are data interfaces and canonical map definitions, with no existence, boundedness, normalization-preservation or invertibility theorem asserted.
